p04: a story scene illustration: This is Hadi's room. The room is very old. Grandma says: Hadi's pillow is old. Dad is at the shop. Dad gives Hadi a new pillow. Dad says: Hadi, be ready. Hadi's sister is Maryam. Maryam's room is far. Nadia gives Hadi cheese. Daniyal gives Hadi yoghurt.
p05: a story scene illustration: Sara goes to school quickly. The school's teacher is Javed. Javed gives Sara a book. Sara says: thank you very much! Javed says: Sara's work is complete. Sara's friend says salaam. Now it is afternoon. At noon the sun is very hot. Salman says: Sara can go quickly. School closes at five o'clock. Salman gives his book to Javed. Javed says: thank you very much, Salman.
p06: a story scene illustration: Uncle's house is near the field. In the field there is grass and there are flowers. Uncle also has a buffalo. The buffalo eats grass and gives milk. We go to uncle's house. The children play in the field. Uncle says: look, the buffalo is very heavy. The sunshine is very hot. Uncle gives milk. The milk is very sweet. Uncle also has a lake. There is a fish in the lake. The little elephant looks at the fish. The elephant does not eat fish. The elephant eats grass.
p07: a story scene illustration: Zainab is a clever girl. She goes to school every day. The school is near the market. There are many things in the market. At the shop there are eggs and clothes. The eggs are fresh. Zainab's dad works in the market. Dad has a big car. In the evening dad goes home. Zainab reads her book. Zainab's room is very big. Zainab's life is very good. The doctor's car is very fast. The boys play in the market. Old grandma has jewellery. The doctor goes to school every day. The girl gives the doctor a book.
p08: a story scene illustration: Tomorrow is Eid. Ahmad and Ali are very happy. Both go to the mosque. After the mosque they go to aunt's house. Aunt's house is near the garden. Aunt has halwa, kebab and naan. Ali likes halwa. Ahmad likes kebab. Aunt says: eat well. Both eat plenty of food. In the evening both go to their own home. Eid is very nice. Khalid's rabbit is white. Khalid gives his rabbit grass. Everyone is very happy. Ali looks at his pen. Ahmad's pen is on the table.
p09: a story scene illustration: Sabir is a clever pupil. In the morning Sabir took a clean shirt. Then he went to school. In school there is the subject of maths. Maths is very important. The teacher says: look at the page. Sabir writes the right answer. The teacher says: very good. Sabir's parrot is in the courtyard. His parrot is a bit big. In the evening Sabir looks at his parrot. The parrot says: Sabir, congratulations! Food is necessary for health. Sabir's mother gives food. Everyone is happy. Tariq goes to school in the morning. Tariq's parrot is very good.
p10: a story scene illustration: Today is Sunday. Brother goes to the shop on his bicycle. At the shop there is flour, potatoes and sweets. Brother took 2 apples and a mango. Then he comes home. Mother gives tea. There are 2 spoons of sugar in the tea. Brother says: thank you, mother! Mother says: no problem. Dad says: the weather is good today. The sky is blue. We will go to the garden at 4 o'clock. Brother likes the garden very much. The sky is clear today. Dad's bicycle is new. Brother says: come, let's go to the garden. Mother gives sweets today. We are all happy today.
p11: a story scene illustration: On Sunday we go to Karachi by train. We come to the station in the morning. The train is very long. Dad took three tickets. Mother has biryani and paratha. In the train there is an old man. He says: Karachi is a very big city. There is the sea there. In the evening we are in Karachi. Aunt's house is near the sea. Aunt gives us tea and biscuits. At night we are all happy. On Monday we go back to Lahore. It rains in September. In December it is very cold. Pakistan is a very good country.
